tool.name: NinjaTrader
tool.description: NinjaTrader is a futures brokerage and charting platform. The software includes simulated trading, and live futures can be traded from desktop, web and mobile.
features: Customizable futures charts and a C# framework for add-ons
Free simulated trading. Live data on the simulator is included for the first 14 days
The homepage lists Micro commissions from $0.09 per contract and intraday margins from $50

plans.name: Platform and simulator
plans.detail: Simulated trading is free. Live market data on the simulator lasts 14 days.

plans.name: Live Micro commission
plans.detail: Per Micro contract, as stated on the homepage.

plans.name: Intraday margin
plans.detail: Homepage figure for getting started. Margin changes by contract.

tool.pricing_note: Figures from the official homepage on 11 Oct 2026. NinjaTrader is a futures broker as well as a platform. ACH and debit card transfers have a $5 minimum on that page. No general deposit minimum was stated.
